fidelity: F2a — Thevenin Equivalent-Circuit Model (1-RC / 2-RC) with Coulomb-counted SOC and lumped thermal ODE
source: Lin et al. (2015) Nature 520, 324-328; Pang et al. (2019) Joule 3(1), 136-148; Guo et al. (2020) Energy Storage Mater. 28, 240-248; Plett (2015) Battery Management Systems Vol.1 (ECM/Coulomb counting)

unit.name: Aluminum-Ion cell (Al / AlCl4-graphite) in AlCl3:EMImCl ionic liquid — physics-lumped ECM
unit.note: Al anode dissolution (Al - 3e- -> Al^3+); AlCl4- intercalation into graphite cathode. Multi-step staging gives ~1.8-2.2 V plateaus. Lin et al. 2015 Nature.

capacity_ref.note: Reference cell capacity (normalized). Lin 2015 reports ~70 mAh/g graphite; cell scaled to 1 Ah

voltage_max.note: Upper charge cutoff. Lin et al. 2015 Nature

R0_ref.note: Series (ohmic) resistance at T_ref. Ionic-liquid electrolyte, low for high-rate Al-ion. Lin 2015 (charge in 1 min)

C1.note: RC-pair 1 capacitance -> tau1 = R1*C1 ~ 18 s (fast Al-ion kinetics)

R2_ref.note: RC-pair 2 (slow diffusion) resistance at T_ref; used only in 2-RC mode

E_a.note: Arrhenius activation energy for resistances. Ionic-liquid moderate T-sensitivity. Guo 2020

alpha_c.note: Capacity temperature coefficient; ionic-liquid viscosity drops with T. Guo 2020

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient (reversible heat). Slight negative on Al insertion. Pang 2019

hA.note: Convective heat-transfer coeff * surface area to ambient

coulomb_eff.note: Coulombic (charge) efficiency; Al-ion >99% with ultra-long cycle life (Lin 2015: 7500+ cycles, no decay)

cycle_life.note: Demonstrated cycle life with ~no capacity decay. Lin et al. 2015 Nature

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) for Al-ion: multi-step graphite/chloroaluminate intercalation, ~1.8-2.2 V plateaus, monotonically increasing in SOC
ocv_coefficients.source: Lin et al. (2015) Nature 520, 324-328; Pang et al. (2019) Joule 3(1), 136-148
ocv_coefficients.note: 5th-order polynomial fit; reproduces two-plateau staging (~2.2 V and ~1.8 V). Monotone increasing on [0,1]. Pang 2019

current_A.note: positive=discharge, negative=charge. Al-ion supports very high C-rates (Lin 2015 charges in ~1 min). |I|<=20 ~ 20C
